_about: Weekly capacity per channel and the capacity each route stage draws per page, the inputs allocate_v2.py plans with (#6740, #7263). Data, not code: change a figure here and re-run. Every figure names its meter and date. Plan FEES are not here and never are: allocate_v2.py allocates capacity, which needs no fee; `--fees <private file>` (ops cost ledger, as route_ocr_v1.py reads it) only adds a dollar column to a private table written outside the repo.
